reviews.name: Leonardo
reviews.title: The Perfect Choice for Our Wedding Photos
reviews.text: We couldn't be happier with Meraki! From the very first contact to the final gallery, everything felt so natural and effortless. They captured every emotion of our wedding day without ever making us feel staged or rushed. The photos are breathtaking and somehow feel exactly like us. Beyond the incredible images, the whole experience was fun like having a friend with a camera who just happened to be insanely talented. Thank you, Meraki, for giving us memories we'll cherish forever.

reviews.name: Alex S.
reviews.title: Great last minute help!
reviews.text: We hired Meraki Art as our last minute wedding ceremony videographer and to set up a live stream of the event. We were very happy with results. Shuhan communicated regularly online and on the phone, which made the process very smooth. This was a last minute request for help to stream our wedding ceremony for guests overseas that could not attend the event. Shuhan was responsive, easy to work with, and truly helped make our special day perfect. We highly recommend her!

reviews.name: Irene & C.
reviews.title: My new go-to Photographer
reviews.text: Shuhan is an energetic, personable, and comforting photographer! It was looking as if we weren't going to be able to find a photographer that fit our wedding budget and needs, but by a stroke of luck, we found Shuhan! She is so kind and easy-going. She made me feel pretty even though I felt so awkward. She is awesome at hyping you up and making you feel special! We had a great mix of candid photos and stylized photos. Communication was great and she was open to hearing our ideas as well. Turn around time for the photos was good. Overall, the photography session felt collaborative and that's our style. You won't go wrong with Shuhan as your photographer!

reviews.name: Matthew C.
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing wedding photographer!
reviews.text: We had Shuhan as our wedding photographer, she was absolutely amazing! From the get-go, her friendly and smiling personality made us feel like we were hanging out with a good friend rather than just working with a vendor. She just has such a great vibe! What really blew us away was the effort she put into getting the perfect shots. She wasn't afraid to climb up on stuff or lie down on the ground to get just the right angle. It was clear she's super dedicated to making every photo spectacular. The photos came out beautifully—each one really captured the emotions and excitement of the day. We're so thankful for her amazing work; she truly made our wedding memories even more special.

reviews.name: Yovene L.
reviews.text: I was looking for a professional and approachable photographer, and Shuhan did not disappoint. She attentively cared for my feelings throughout the process, checking to make sure I wasn't uncomfortable or awkward, which made me feel very relaxed during the shoot. She also kept telling me how beautiful I was, something I had never heard so frequently before. For a moment, I truly believed I was beautiful, and I think this may have helped me with my wedding photos.

reviews.name: Karin G.
reviews.text: Shuhan takes the most stunning photos!!! On top of that, when we asked for an extra hour of shooting at the last minute, she was so cool about it and even waited an extra hour for us to finish our meal before starting up again. Plus, she was super considerate when I had to walk barefoot after wearing high heels all day—Shuhan really went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable. We seriously couldn't have asked for a better experience!
